parsed.explanation: The quote is verbatim and means what the objector says: the text explicitly lists 'prove shrinkage stops (equivalently: finitely many permanents / S_∞ finitely generated)' as the remaining crux, i.e., unproved. Nothing elsewhere in the write-up proves the finiteness/large-prime-erasure lemma (F): Lemmas A–D are stated as proved but none establishes that membership depends on finitely many primes or that H_n stabilizes; the only support for stabilization is the empirical run ('Empirics ... shrinkage ALWAYS stops'). The proposed potential argument ('min disjoint-pair product is nondecreasing; need to rule out it →∞') is explicitly incomplete. Without this, L and T cannot be constructed and the periodicity assembly fails, so the lower_bound obligation is unmet and the proof incomplete as written.
